resources.string:
A movie discovery app powered by The Movie Database
This is my first app inside my Android Kitchen sink, and it served to get me up to date on the latest concepts in Android and Jetpack Compose.
It covers:

- MVVM Architecture in Jetpack Compose

- Kotlin coroutines

- The new Compose Navigation graph

- API calls using Retrofit

- Image caching and loading using Coil (wanted to explore an alternative to Glide)

- Dependency Injection with Hilt

- Unit testing with Turbine, RoboElectric, and MockK (not forgetting JUnit, of course)


Some AI was used, but it was mostly to understand whatever code I was copying into it.
